_notes.base: new = the build makes a new project by code, named like the last folder of paths.project, with one Ouflex A (device_type picks another type). Or the folder of an empty project to copy, e.g. C:\agentwork\base\OuflexA_empty from setup
_notes.modbus: one rule: Holding registers only (the only kind the slave offers); set values 1000+n, analog measurements 1100+n, status bits 1150+n, n = declaration order; clear of system registers 2..7, 14 and the automatic 201..
_notes.AO: AO default in a new project is TX_OUT 0..100 %; set explicitly so the verification checks it
